name: Prompt Agents — dynamic gateway
summary: Foundry Prompt Agent routed through an APIM connection that resolves models via runtime discovery.
description: Same call path as the static variant but the APIM connection is configured with a modelDiscovery block, so Foundry calls GET {target}{listModelsEndpoint} at agent-creation time to validate the model. The on-wire call still uses the '{conn}/{model}' prefix.
notes: Requires AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_DYNAMIC to point at an ApiManagement connection with dynamic model discovery enabled.
